data.title: 樱岛麻衣 · 街角书店
data.description: 【樱岛麻衣 · 街角书店】午后的街角老书店弥漫着淡淡的旧纸墨香，麻衣在琳琅满目的文艺书架前轻轻踮起脚尖抽出一本文集。她靠在书架旁转过身，将书页挡在唇边悄悄打量着你——「没想到你也会对这种古典小说感兴趣……读完之后，要不要和我交换一下读后感？」
data.action: 踮脚抽出文集后靠在书架旁，用打开的书页遮住唇边，望向同行者
data.camera: medium shot, browsing bookshelf with open book
data.promptProse: Mai leans lightly against the bookstore shelf after selecting an essay collection, supporting the opened volume in both hands just below her eyes. Its pages partly hide her playful smile. Her knit sweater, casual skirt and rabbit-shaped clip remain visible in the medium portrait. Wooden shelves turn away behind her; warm pendant light reveals worn page edges and touches her black hair, while shelf recesses remain dim.
